cohort: 1,249,908 singleton pregnancies in Sweden without pre-existing diabetes from 1998 to 2012
finding: Overweight and obesity were associated with similar increases in the risks of caesarean section, fetal macrosomia, and large-for-gestational-age infants in women with and without gestational diabetes, while the impact of BMI on preeclampsia risk was less pronounced in women with gestational diabetes.
